messages:
nina: Hit the quickstart CLI and it just hangs on "Waiting for workspace provisioning..." (spinner for >10m).
devon: same, tried on mac and linux
nina: No billing modal popped up in the browser, console shows workspace page but 'Enable billing' is greyed out.
mel: can you grab logs? I'll check onboarding service
nina: logs pasted:
```
POST /api/onboard 504
{"error":"no-billing-link","workspace_id":"w_1234"}
```
devon: can you run `redwood whoami --json` and paste the workspace id
nina: whoami -> {"user":"nina","workspace":"w_1234"}
infra-bot: Rollout: onboarding-service v2.3.1 deployed at 2024-05-03T18:42Z
mel: heads-up v2.3.1 changed redirect for orgs created via CLI; it expects workspace.billing_enabled=true which isn't set for trial-invite flows
sam: workaround — create a workspace via Console > Billing > Enable trial, then re-run CLI
nina: confirmed workaround worked, quickstart proceeded. thanks :tada:
mel: filed GH issue #4282, PR draft to add clear CLI error and avoid infinite spinner
nina: suggested CLI message: "Workspace pending billing. Open Console to complete setup: <link>"
sam: adding to quickstart UX ticket and will add telemetry to detect this path
devon: thx all
